title: Electrum wallet data
whyItMatters: Electrum keeps wallet files holding keys and transaction history. Losing them can make the coins unrecoverable without the seed phrase.
source: Elastic detection-rules macOS wallet paths reference ~/Library/Application Support/Electrum - https://github.com/elastic/detection-rules/issues/6616
notes: Config and wallet files are counted only. Wallets kept at a custom path outside Application Support are not covered.
